resources.string: Makes ATAK work with a mouse: wheel zoom at the cursor, wheel scrolling in panes, click and drag to pan, a Back button.
ATAK expects a finger. This plugin makes it behave for a mouse or trackpad, on a desktop, DeX or a Chromebook. It is working now; there is nothing to set up.

• Wheel zooms in and out at the cursor, one step per click. How big a step is the Wheel zoom setting below.
• Click and drag pans the map 1:1.
• A click selects, as a tap does. Long press opens the radial menu.
• Things ATAK lets you drag, such as a range-and-bearing end or a shape vertex, still drag.
• Wheel scrolls the pane or list under the cursor, and never zooms the map behind it.\n• The ‹ button on the left edge, and the Escape key, are Back.\n• Clicks land in text fields, so you can type.
On a phone or tablet used with a finger, Cursorwerx does nothing at all.
